item.title: optimize_anything Goes omni: Composing Optimizers into Meta-Optimizer Pipelines
item.author: Shangyin Tan
Lakshya A Agrawal

Koushik Sen

item.description: optimize_anything now supports customizable optimizers that can be composed into meta-optimizer pipelines. Why compose? Because no single optimizer wins everywhere. Our omni meta-optimizer combines the best of each and beats every standalone optimizer on Frontier-CS tasks under a matched budget.

item.title: Batching the Reflective Optimization Loop: Parallel Proposals Make GEPA Faster and Better
item.author: Jialin Zhang
Lakshya A Agrawal
Shangyin Tan
Donghyun Lee
Lutfi Eren Erdogan
Dan Klein
Koushik Sen
Alexandros G. Dimakis
Matei Zaharia
item.description: GEPA now supports proposing and evaluating a batch of candidates on each optimization step instead of one candidate at a time. In our sweep on two tasks, most batched runs finished in half the wall-clock time or less, and the fastest in about a quarter to a third. Batched settings also achieved higher held-out test scores: from 68.9% to 72.1% on LiveBench-Math (with 2×2) and from 49.0% to 60.0% on HoVer (with 8×1).
